title: rifft~

messages.description: real part of frequency domain signal
imaginary part of frequency domain signal
real part of frequency domain signal

body:
[rifft~] does an inverse Fourier transform back to a real signal, from the real and imaginary parts of a spectrum as [rfft~] outputs them.

The analysis size is one block, which you can set with [block~] or [switch~]. There is no normalization, so an FFT followed by an IFFT has a gain of N.
